metadata.title: A Two-Stage Construction of Positive Curvature on the Gromoll-Meyer Sphere
metadata.abstract: We construct an explicit one-parameter family of smooth metrics on the Gromoll-Meyer exotic seven-sphere, converging in $C^\infty$ to a fixed further Cheeger deformation of the Eschenburg-Kerin metric and having strictly positive sectional curvature for all sufficiently small positive parameter values. The first perturbation preserves the totally geodesic flats of one zero-plane family while making curvature positive near the other; the second removes the remaining zero curvature. The metric and the proof were discovered by the Odin Automatic AI Research Agent.

analysis.workSummary: 作者声称通过两阶段扰动，在 Gromoll–Meyer 奇异七球面上构造显式正截面曲率度量族，光滑收敛到固定的进一步 Cheeger 变形度量。
analysis.breakthrough: 第一阶段处理一类零平面，第二阶段消除剩余零曲率；摘要明确披露 Odin AI 代理发现构造与证明。
analysis.limitations: 需独立核查全部二平面的统一正性、扰动参数选择与全局光滑性；摘要层面不能确认长期问题已解决。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.aiEvidence: 摘要明确声明度量和证明由 Odin Automatic AI Research Agent 发现。
analysis.priorityReason: 正曲率与奇异球面核心问题相关，列为极高核查优先级而非正确性评价。
